```{r report-hero}
# Sample identity band. The clinical overview below it (gene-list chips, key findings,
# genome-wide biomarkers, sequencing cards) is _gene_filter.qmd + _overview.qmd; the
# "## Overview" heading here is what puts all three in one TOC entry.
mode_css = if (outputs$mode == "matched") "is-matched" else "is-tumour-only"
tags$header(
  class = "report-hero",
  # No eyebrow: Quarto's own title line directly above already says what this document is.
  div(class = "report-hero__title", params$sample_id),
  div(class = "report-hero__badges",
    tags$span(class = paste("report-badge", mode_css), toupper(outputs$mode)),
    tags$span(class = "report-badge is-meta", toupper(params$reference)),
    tags$span(class = "report-badge is-meta", toupper(params$sex))
  )
)
```
